dishes.name: Amasya corek
dishes.desc: A yeast pastry rolled around a ground poppy-seed paste, with walnut kneaded into the dough and an egg-yolk glaze. Made at home for guests across Amasya.

dishes.name: Topuz kebab
dishes.desc: Grilled meat served on a mace-shaped iron holder, usually with several kinds of meat, peppers and rice. A celebration dish of Amasya, widely served in Merzifon.

dishes.name: Singir kebab
dishes.desc: Lamb and salted eggplant rings alternated on skewers and turned by hand over charcoal on a special frame. An Amasya kebab you rarely find elsewhere.

dishes.name: Tokat kebab
dishes.desc: Bone-in lamb with eggplant in a tomato sauce, cooked in the Tokat style. The best-known dish of Tokat, the neighbouring city in this region.

dishes.name: Corum leblebi
dishes.desc: Roasted chickpeas cooked over wood fire, sold plain, peppered or sugared. Çorum is Turkey's leblebi town and the snack is sold across its markets.
